answer: The loom stands strung in the long room, warp threads stretched tight from beam to beam. Proof of joiner via dovetail fit tally — a joint the joiner cuts only after 31 joints sit flush without one gaping, each joint cut by the joiner himself. violet throws the shuttle through the shed and beats the weft home with the reed. pearl ties each broken thread with a knot and keeps the selvedge straight. quill cuts the finished cloth off the beam and rolls it up. A weaver earns the count with 44 yards woven without one flaw in the weave, and the forty-fifth still shows a skipped thread.
